description: This Java source file defines the 'InvalidNamespacesException' class, a custom exception used within the Eclipse Ditto project to indicate that a provided list of namespaces for a search is invalid. It includes builder patterns, JSON parsing capabilities, and error code definitions specific to namespace validation errors.
